verdict.rationale: Neon provides project-scoped and organization-scoped API keys with immediate revocation (neon-supp-api-key-scoping), plus MCP-server-level least-privilege controls (read-only mode, category scoping, project scoping) that are independently verified via a live probe returning a scoped, read-only tool grant (neon-probe-7, neon-supp-mcp-scoping-readonly). The MCP tool surface itself even exposes 'Issue a scoped credential on the branch' tooling for agents (neon-supp-mcp-tool-surface), directly matching the story. missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of scoped-credential issuance in practice beyond vendor docs and probes.
